model: ped movement assignment (which phases / ped overlaps each ped input calls)
decision: per ped input: every candidate movement with p >= threshold, after the ped recall rule; none -> in_recall when a movement of the signal is gated, else no_movement
number_free: no input, phase or overlap number is a feature or breaks a tie; training rows in a canonical order; tests/test_ped_invariance.py renumbers the raw log
candidates: every ped input with presses (90) x every phase 1-16 with a 21 or 45 and every ped overlap 1-32 with a 67 or 68 at that signal in the window
labels: the controllers' saved ped settings (2026-10-28): ped detector plan 1 for every signal, call phase + additional phases / call overlap; rows gated by the recall rule are not trained on

accuracy.source: signal-grouped 5-fold over Sep + Oct 2026, threshold fixed at 0.5; exact = predicted set == configured set (movements with ped activity, without recall links the log cannot show)
